population.value: patients with recurrent weight gain who had undergone metabolic bariatric surgery

intervention.value: 5:2 intermittent fasting (IF) (75% caloric restriction on two days per week)

comparator.value: continuous caloric restriction (CCR) (25% divided into three meals)

primary_findings.quote: The difference between the two groups remained within the predefined non-inferiority margin of 4 kg (-0.13; 95% CI: -2.90 to 2.62).
